listing.title: Deck the Shelves Shirt, Bookish Christmas Tee, Book Christmas Tree Shirt, Book Lover Gift, Black Cat Book Shirt, Librarian Gift
listing.description: A Christmas tree made of stacked books in deep red, forest green, gold and navy, wrapped in a string of warm lights with a gold star on top, presents at its foot and a black cat keeping watch, painted in layered watercolor. "Deck the Shelves" in serif lettering on top and "bookish & bright" in script below. For the reader, librarian or book-club friend who would rather decorate a shelf than a tree.
